_meta.claim: Unlike rise/set and the phase search, the eclipse solvers read the VALUE of a non-bit-identical separation, a parabolic vertex and Illinois false position both interpolate. Probes are still truncated to whole milliseconds and contacts still rounded to them, so the prediction is agreement within a millisecond or two on instants and at the platform-trig floor on magnitudes. The Go test measures which.
